articles.title: CrowdStrike in Talks to Acquire Zscaler in One of the Biggest Cybersecurity Deals Ever
articles.summary:
CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler in a deal that could rank among the largest in cybersecurity history. Bloomberg first reported the discussions on Friday, November 20, citing two people familiar with the matter who said talks were ongoing. The discussions could still end without an agreement. Neither company has announced a deal or […]
